label: evo-depth.libero_spatial.optimized

optimized.note: clean run after killing stray processes; tail latency varies between runs (std 7.7 to 55 ms across runs)

changes.name: InternViT via TensorRT FP16 engine
changes.how: torch.onnx.export in fp32, trtexec --fp16 (fp32 accumulate); one 1x3x448x448 engine call per tile

changes.name: action head: context K/V computed once per observation
changes.how: replaced per-step nn.MultiheadAttention cross-attention with split_proj once + SDPA per step

changes.name: action head: 50-step sampling loop captured as a CUDA graph
changes.how: side-stream warmup, torch.cuda.graph capture, copy_ into static buffers, replay

changes.name: prompt fusion: tokenizer cache + vectorised mask
changes.how: one tokenization per prompt, host-side position read, single vectorised attention-mask zeroing

changes.name: image preprocessing: torch fast path instead of PIL round trip
changes.env: always on (auto, only for square RGB tensors of image_size)
changes.validation: action max_abs 0.0054, mean 0.0011 (bf16 rounding) - NOT bit-identical: bicubic resize at the same size is not an exact identity
changes.how: quantise to 8 bit like PIL does, normalise with ImageNet stats, skip dynamic_preprocess for square inputs

attempted_and_dropped.name: DA3 DPT via TensorRT
attempted_and_dropped.dropped_because: exported graph permutes tokens: per-token cosine median 0.9974 but overall 0.890; sorted row means match at 0.9996. A PyTorch view() on a non-contiguous tensor maps to a different element order than ONNX Reshape.
attempted_and_dropped.note: gain would have been 135 ms (13%); fix needs per-op bisection of the DPT head shape transforms

caveats: random input; no accuracy measurement on real observations
LIBERO simulation eval still not run
CUDA graph reuses static buffers: do not call get_action concurrently from two threads in one process
